title: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation Strategies for Large Language Model-Based Travel Mode Choice Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2508.17527v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurately predicting travel mode choice is essential for effective transportation planning, yet traditional statistical and machine learning models are constrained by rigid assumptions, limited contextual reasoning, and reduced transferability. This study explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) as a more flexible and context-aware approach to travel mode choice prediction, enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground predictions in empirical data. We develop a modular framework for integrating RAG into LLM-based travel mode choice prediction and evaluate four retrieval strategies: basic RAG, RAG with balanced retrieval, RAG with a cross-encoder for re-ranking, and RAG with balanced retrieval and a cross-encoder for re-ranking. These strategies are tested across three LLM architectures (OpenAI GPT-4o, o4-mini, and o3) to examine the interaction between model reasoning capabilities and retrieval methods. U

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的出行方式选择预测中检索增强生成策略的基准测试
translated_abstract: 准确预测出行方式选择对于有效的交通规划至关重要，然而传统的统计和机器学习模型受限于僵化的假设、有限的上下文推理能力和较差的迁移性。本研究探索了大语言模型（LLMs）作为一种更灵活且具备上下文感知能力的出行方式选择预测方法的潜力，并通过检索增强生成（RAG）技术将预测基于实证数据进行支撑。我们开发了一个模块化框架，用于将RAG集成到基于LLM的出行方式选择预测中，并评估了四种检索策略：基础RAG、带平衡检索的RAG、带交叉编码器重排序的RAG，以及带平衡检索和交叉编码器重排序的RAG。这些策略在三种LLM架构（OpenAI GPT-4o、o4-mini和o3）上进行了测试，以考察模型推理能力与检索方法之间的交互作用。
tldr: 本研究首次系统性地基准测试了四种检索增强生成策略在基于大语言模型的出行方式选择预测中的表现，并揭示了不同模型推理能力与检索方法之间的交互效应。
en_tdlr: This study systematically benchmarks four retrieval-augmented generation strategies for LLM-based travel mode choice prediction, revealing the interaction effects between model reasoning capabilities and retrieval methods.
